title: Principal Schema
description: An identity-bearing noun (a person or thing with an assigned identity). The identity is the basis for determining the principal's authorization and capabilities, evaluated against policies. `principal_kind` is required because accountability depends on it: per CORE-INVARIANT 13, only a HUMAN principal can hold the Accountable role; a `thing` principal cannot be accountable and must never make permanent/risky-permanent decisions alone. Enforced by lore_validate.py Check 4.

identity.description: the assigned identity (the basis for authz/capability).

policies.description: object-ref id(s) of policies that govern this principal.
